projects.name: The majlis server
projects.description: Set up and maintained a home server on an old office PC running Debian, hosting a family photo library, a recipe site, and a network-wide ad blocker, each in its own container using a single Docker Compose file. Automated full machine rebuilds using playbooks, verified by wiping the disk twice. Created a shell script to monitor service health every five minutes with Telegram alerts on failure. Implemented nightly backups to a second disk and weekly off-site backups to a relative's house.

projects.name: Publishing the club website without FTP
projects.description: Migrated the Hail Tech Club website to AWS free tier, using a storage bucket behind a content delivery network. Set up automatic build and publish on every merge to the main branch, preventing broken builds from being published. Wrote a two-page guide for future committee members to maintain the site.
